mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 2.0% in a monthly reading, it indicates aggressive monetary easing that stimulates corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 2.0), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 1-year moving average, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals robust job market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 in a monthly reading, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that signals potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300.0 thousand units in a monthly reading, it indicates a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized indicates persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a tight labor market that drives wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
